description: This PHP class CandidateDecorator provides a decorator pattern implementation for the Candidate entity, adding additional methods for setting the added person by ID and formatting the date of application.

classes.name: CandidateDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Candidate entity that adds methods for setting the candidate's added person and formatting the date of application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CandidateDecorator with a Candidate object.

methods.name: setAddedPersonById
methods.description: Sets the 'added person' of the candidate using an employee ID.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of application for the candidate.
